title: Harden the final mesh pipeline independently of editor interaction
description:
Source: docs/tasks/tickets/CC-061-final-mesh-pipeline-hardening.md
Source key: CC-061
Source status: Backlog
Source priority: P2

## Summary
Improve final SDF mesh quality and throughput without making final generation the editor interaction path.

## Scope
Preserve the dense path as a reference. Measure sparse active regions, direct edge ownership, Compact Isocontours, cached gradients, and asynchronous generation as separate changes. Keep deterministic traversal, topology, winding, UV, and material evidence.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Final generation has repeatable measurements at multiple preview qualities.
- Optimizations preserve scalar parity, watertightness, winding, appearance, and deterministic output.
- The editor can use the interactive proxy while final generation runs or is deferred.
- No final-mesh optimization changes authoritative DNA semantics.

## Validation
Run benchmark fixtures and Unity topology/determinism tests. Record sample counts, active cells, timings, allocations, triangle quality, and residual risks.

## Findings
The competitor comparison separates interactive latency from final mesh quality. Existing profiling still justifies sparse sampling and compact contour work, but those changes solve a different problem from 60 Hz editing.

## Blockers
CC-057 should establish the editor responsiveness contract before asynchronous refinement is coupled to the window.

## Next Step
Capture a baseline matrix, then choose the smallest independently measurable extraction optimization.

comments.body:
ROUND 2 (BeastMaster sub-slice, S01 gradient/winding regression gate): S01 verdict = ALREADY GUARDED at HEAD 5a82401; NO production change. Evidence: MarchingCubesExtractor.EmitTriangle winding prefers TryEstimateGradient, which returns false when the containing cell has any non-finite (+inf/NaN) corner (added e1b078a), else falls back to EstimateGradient whose per-axis EstimateAxis is finite-aware (d040ed6: center non-finite ->0; +inf neighbor skipped via one-sided finite diff; never +inf - +inf as finite). Both gradient paths are always finite, so the winding decision Dot(faceNormal, gradient)>=0 never consumes NaN/Inf. DensityGrid.cs and MarchingCubesExtractor.cs are clean at HEAD (no uncommitted changes).

Added committed regression gate (test-only): Assets/Scripts/Tests/Runtime/DensityGridGradientPolicyTests.cs (+.meta). Six tests lock the gradient policy across finite, one-sided (field present on one side of an absent boundary), and invalid/absent (+inf/NaN corner, +inf center) cases, and assert the end-to-end winding decision never consumes NaN/Inf (per-triangle re-derived winding reference is finite and consistent; output finite/watertight/no co-directional edge; fixture grid provably contains +inf corners so not vacuous). Deterministic hand-written ramp field injected via internal MutableSamples seam.

Validation: git diff --check exit 0; dotnet build Tests.Runtime exit 0; Unity PlayMode focused 6/6 passed; full Runtime PlayMode suite 532/532 passed (526 prior + 6 new). Test-only => no benchmark run (GenerateDataBenchmark not invoked; no production extraction HOT PATH touched). Broader TSK-0065 optimization matrix (sparse/compact-isocontour etc.) is separate scope and NOT attempted. Did NOT commit/push (orchestrator reviews).
